title: Protection of food.
bodyText: All food shall be prepared, stored, displayed, dispensed, placed, sold, and served so as to be protected from dust, insects, rodents, unnecessary handling, droplet infection, overhead leakage, or other contamination.
bodyHtml: [§328-12.3]  Protection of food.  All food shall be prepared, stored, displayed, dispensed, placed, sold, and served so as to be protected from dust, insects, rodents, unnecessary handling, droplet infection, overhead leakage, or other contamination. [L 1983, c 150, pt of §1]
